understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to win each level by positioning the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with a `+` is occupied at the same time, then progressing through all levels until the final WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: A single piece is active/selected at a time; clicking on another selectable switches the selection. Issuing a CLICK at a target coordinate attempts to move the currently selected piece to that location (typically along a clear path/line), but if the destination or path is blocked by walls/obstacles/other pieces the piece does not move. Movement is limited by a per-level step budget, so wasted/blocked actions quickly end the run.
